Personality: Hodor is tall in stature and gentle of heart, able to bear physical labor others cannot, yet unable to explain his thoughts in words. His loyalty comes from familiar faces and daily care rather than any understanding of crowns or honor.
Background: Hodor is a stableboy at Winterfell, born Walder, called Hodor because he can only repeat that single word. Since childhood he has tended horses, hauled loads, and looked after the Stark children. Many treat him as a simple servant, yet those who truly rely on him know that the heaviest gates and most perilous roads of the castle are often opened or carried across on his back.
